summary: Golf scorecard application with front nine/back nine subtotals and PDF leaderboard generation

existing_features.title: Display a subtotal for holes 1-9 (front nine) in each player's score entry card, calculating the sum of scores entered for holes 1 through 9
Display a subtotal for holes 10-18 (back nine) in each player's score entry card, calculating the sum of scores entered for holes 10 through 18
Add a PDF generation feature to the leaderboard view that exports the calculated standings to PDF format

Add subtotal for holes 10-18 (back nine) for each player
Generate PDF of the leaderboard once calculated
